newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA cotton export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net Upland sales of 75,900 running bales (RB) were 21 percent more than the previous week and exceeded the 4-week average by 7 percent.
The major increases were for China (19,600 RB), Hong Kong (11,000 RB), Indonesia (8,500 RB), and Turkey (8,300 RB).
Sales of 61,400 RB for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were primarily for South Korea (32,900 RB) and Canada (15,000 RB).

Exports of 122,300 RB were off one-quarter from the previous week and 11 percent from the 4-week average. Asian destinations accounted for 49 percent of the week's shipments; Western Hemisphere, 35 percent; and West European, 16 percent.
